package rulefixtures

	"log"
	grpc "google.golang.org/grpc"
)

// scenario for grpc_unary_interceptor_per_rpc: interceptor/middleware construction inside RPC handler methods instead of at server setup
// fixture polarity: positive; family: library; severity: info.
func scenario414Positive(ctx context.Context, method string, req, reply interface{}, cc *grpc.ClientConn, invoker grpc.UnaryInvoker, opts ...grpc.CallOption) error {
	interceptor := func(ctx context.Context, method string, req, reply interface{}, cc *grpc.ClientConn, invoker grpc.UnaryInvoker, opts ...grpc.CallOption) error {
		log.Printf("intercepting call to %s per RPC", method)
		return invoker(ctx, method, req, reply, cc, opts...)
	}
	return interceptor(ctx, method, req, reply, cc, invoker, opts...)
}
